moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-turbulence-wobble, written here): SVG filter on the text: feTurbulence baseFrequency 0.02, numOctaves 2, seed = floor(t × 10) (new pose every 100 ms; the SMIL source cycles seeds 0–9 each second); feDisplacementMap scale 5–15 px (SVG 10), so outlines squirm like boiling line art. GSAP: scale 0 → 12, 0.6 s sine.inOut yoyo, 0.8 s rest. Demo: scale ramps 0 → 12 over 0.3–0.8 s, back 2.4–2.85 s; loop 3 s. Params: baseFrequency (0.02) · scale: độ uốn (5–15 px) · rate: đổi dáng (10 lần/giây) · octaves (2).
